variants.name: 苍劲枯笔
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / controlled lettering refinement.
Input image 1 is the user's chosen composition and edit target for the original Chinese game title. Make one refined standalone transparent logo. Preserve its compact, nearly square TWO-ROW composition, character positions, and relative scales: oversized black “逆转” above, large warm-gold “五丈原” below, both rows approximately the same width. Upper row about 55% of the combined lettering height. Keep the rows closely nested like this exact reference, with the sweeping 辶 bottom stroke of 逆 bridging the narrow gap above 五丈原. Do not change it to a long horizontal wordmark or a tiny subtitle. Approximate canvas ratio 1.2:1, adequate clear padding around ALL brush tips.
Exact and only text, in simplified Chinese: first row “逆转”, second row “五丈原”. Five correctly constructed recognizable characters. Maintain original bespoke calligraphic identity; no named commercial font and no other game logo.
User change: visibly stronger REAL CHINESE BRUSH CALLIGRAPHY, especially the top two characters. Repaint strokes with authentic pressure/release, curved wrist movement, supple changing widths, exposed fibrous tips, directional dry-brush gaps, occasional pooled ink, natural irregular edges. Brush structure itself must look handwritten, not just distress noise added to solid shapes. “逆” has a free leftward sweep and rising upper strokes, “转” has free rightward finishing strokes; both left and right feel unrestrained but contained within the compact footprint. Do not extend them into enormous horizontal wings. Preserve the correct 车+专 skeleton in 转.
Palette invariant: 逆转 predominantly deep matte black, sparse warm gold brushed into a few stroke interiors; 五丈原 predominantly warm ochre/antique gold with subtle golden-yellow/amber changes, small dark cinnabar-red ends. Restrained red runs along selected lower tips, as in the reference. Gold looks like hand-brushed mineral pigment and fine worn gold leaf, not chrome. All five characters must have brushlike contours; no heavy black outline around gold.
True transparent alpha around and between the letters. The checkerboard in the screenshot is ONLY a viewer background: remove it entirely, do not paint a checkerboard. The little bottom-right “画布” control is UI: remove it. No background, no white rectangle, no UI, no watermarks, no seal, no extra text, no scenery. No 3D bevel, extruded blocks, geometric shield, straight mechanical edges or rigid symmetry. Cinematic historical Chinese title, clear silhouette, independently drawn lettering.
Variant 01, closest to the chosen layout. Increase brush strength without losing its heavy compact presence. Broad dark strokes carry fine parallel dry-brush channels following stroke direction. More broken, fibrous edges and lively tapered endings on 逆转; approximately 80% ink coverage and 20% breathable dry-brush in the heavy strokes, still dark and readable. Give 五丈原 restrained dry-brush gold pigment on supple contours. Keep reference's upright energy with small natural tilts. Gold accents sparse, muted red on lower tails. The difference must be clearly visible at normal viewing size.

variants.name: 水墨飞白
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand, original Chinese brush-calligraphy logo refinement.
Image 1 is the user's selected composition. Preserve ONLY its compact nested two-row layout, approximate relative character sizes, and black-gold-red color distribution. Redraw the FIVE CHARACTERS as actual brush handwriting. This must be a materially more calligraphic reinterpretation, not a surface filter on the same solid vector letter silhouettes.
Only text: “逆转” on the first row, “五丈原” on the second row. Correct simplified Chinese. Compact approximately 1.2:1 logo, top two letters black and larger individually; bottom three letters large warm ochre gold. The two complete rows have approximately equal width. Keep the swooping 辶 stroke of 逆 between the rows. Comfortable clear margin around every tip. Do not make 五丈原 a tiny subtitle.
MAJOR SINGLE STYLE CHANGE: genuine hand-written Chinese running-script brush strokes, flat ink and mineral pigment. Visibly use the side of a split-hair brush: heavy strokes opened by long tapered parallel unpainted channels, strong coarse dry-brush feathering in their direction of travel, lively uneven ink loading, natural pressure-sensitive curving edges. Exterior outlines are organically frayed and supple, interior strokes have recognizable purposeful open white/transparent streaks, not random scratches. Every stroke should reveal the brush's direction and pressure. 逆转 retains large dense BLACK ink cores, with 20–30% naturally broken dry-brush areas along the broader strokes. Both outer sides finish in expressive flying tapered brush hairs. The black letters must feel spontaneous and free, not carved, not rigid, and stay legible with correct radicals.
The lower gold 五丈原 must ALSO be rewritten with the same pressure-controlled BRUSH handling. Pure flat ochre-gold pigment, slight amber and pale-gold loading variations within each stroke, flowing brush fibers with negative-space streaks. Absolutely NO dark extruded lower edge, bevel shading, shiny highlight, 3D relief, chiseled serif or sculptural block volume. Gold is painted with a brush, not cast metal. Red is limited to subtle cinnabar ends on a few lower strokes; black upper lettering gets only three or four thin sparse gold dry-brush marks.
Imagine a Chinese calligrapher wrote all five glyphs by hand in one session on paper; now extract ONLY the painted strokes and remove the paper, preserving transparent dry-brush gaps. No paper texture/background is included. Flat light, NO directional object lighting or cast shadows.
The reference's checkerboard and bottom-right UI “画布” are not part of the logo: remove all grid and UI. True transparent alpha, not a rendered checkerboard, no background, watermark, icons, seals, frames, emblems, extra words. Original bespoke lettering, no existing commercial font or competitor mark.
